request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"The Environmental Student Assembly is putting on the Earth Week Fair, a campus gathering for USC students who care about sustainability or are just curious about it. The fair brings together tables from campus sustainability groups, a clothing swap and a series of talks. We are reaching out to invite you to co-host the event with our club as a fellow recognized student organization. Your involvement would help students find a welcoming place to learn, swap clothes and meet the groups already working on these issues across campus. We would love to talk about how we could plan it together.","contains_instructions":false}
